αἰκίζω: to treat injuriously, to plague, torment
αἰσθάνομαι: to perceive, apprehend by the senses, to see, hear, feel
αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
βεβαιόω: to make firm, confirm, establish, secure, warrant, make good
βουλεύω: to take counsel, deliberate, concert measures
γουνάζομαι: to clasp by the knees: implore
διίημι: drive, thrust through (a weapon); disband (an army)
διαβαίνω: to cross (a river, etc.); to stand with feet apart
διαδηλέομαι: to do great harm to, tear to pieces
διεργάζομαι: to make an end of, kill, destroy
δύναμαι: to be able, capable, strong enough
δύω: (trans.) cause to enter or sink (dunk); (intr.) enter; get into; sink; set (of sun/stars)
εἰσοράω: to look into, look upon, view, behold
εὔχομαι: to pray, offer prayers, pay one’s vows, make a vow
θεάομαι: to look on, gaze at, view, behold
καθορμίζω: to bring a ship to harbor, bring to anchor
καταισθάνομαι: to come to full perception of
καταλέγω: recount, tell at length and in order; enrol, enlist
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
κτάομαι: to procure for oneself, to get, gain, acquire
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather
λανθάνω: to escape notice, to be unknown, unseen, unnoticed
λοχάω: to lie in wait for, to watch, waylay, entrap
μέμφομαι: to blame, censure, find fault with
μήδομαι: to be minded, to intend, resolve
νεμεσάω: to feel just resentment, to be wroth at undeserved
παραλέγω: talk nonsense/beside the point; pluck out hair; sail along a coast
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
πεμπάζω: to count on the five fingers
περιγίγνομαι: to be superior to; to survive
πολιορκέω: to hem in a city, blockade, beleaguer, besiege
πονέω: to work hard, do work, suffer toil
προαιρέω: to bring forth; (mid.) to choose, to prefer
προστίθημι: to add, to apply, to close (a door); mid. to join (a group), take as an ally
προτίθημι: to place before, to propose, to prefer
σεύω: to put in quick motion: to drive, hunt, chase away
συγκατεργάζομαι: to help achieve; join in murdering
συμφράζομαι: to join in considering, to take counsel with
τεύχω: to make ready, make, build, work
φυλάσσω: to keep watch and ward, keep guard
χρίω: to touch on the surface: to rub
ψηφίζω: (mid.) to vote; (act.) to count with pebbles
ἀμύσσω: to scratch, tear, wound, lacerate, mangle
ἀνέχω: to hold up; (mid.) endure, put up with
ἀναίνομαι: to reject with contempt, turn one’s back on, spurn
ἀναβάλλω: (to throw up;) strike up (a song); delay
ἀντιτάσσω: to set opposite to, range in battle against
ἀπογίγνομαι: to be away from, have no part in
ἀποδίδωμι: to give back, give what is due; (mid.) sell
ἀπολογέομαι: to speak in defence, defend oneself
ἀπονίναμαι: have the use or enjoyment of a thing
ἀσπάζομαι: to welcome kindly, bid welcome, greet
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἄγαμαι: to wonder, be astonished; be envious
ἄρχω: (to be first) to rule, to begin
ἅπτω: to fasten, bind fast; set on fire; mid. touch
ἐγγίγνομαι: to be born or bred in; be innate, be native
ἐντύνω: to equip, deck out, get ready
ἐξεργάζομαι: to work out, make completely, finish off, bring to perfection
ἐπιτίθημι: to lay, put on; (mid.) to attack
ἐποχέομαι: to be carried upon, ride upon
ἐρύω: to drag along the ground, drag, draw
ἱκνέομαι: to come, reach, approach; to supplicate, beseech; to befit
ἵζω: to make to sit, seat, place
ὀπάζω: to make to follow, send with
ὁπλίζω: to equip, make ready; to arm
ὄλλυμι: to destroy, make an end of
ὑπερβάλλω: to throw over; outdo, surpass, postpone
